run_lm_embedding_generation: run the main function to generate language model embeddings using Hydra config and PyTorch Lightning
run_test_single_path: run the nested run_test function to fit and test a single test path with context embeddings
generate_embeddings_with_plus_separator: generate embeddings for multiple test paths by splitting paths with a plus sign separator
generate_embeddings_with_wildcard: generate embeddings for 10 test paths by replacing backslash question mark wildcards with indices
configure_mlm_encoding_task: configure the MaskedLanguageModelingEncodingTask target and disable training batches for embedding generation
